@font-face { font-family: "Minecraft UI"; font-display: swap; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,") format('woff2'); }
:root {
--mc-openai: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-openai-fast: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-openai-heavy: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-claude: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-claude-fast: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-claude-heavy: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-gemini: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-gemini-fast: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-gemini-heavy: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-opencode: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-opencode-fast: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-opencode-heavy: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-creeper: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-creeper-fast: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-creeper-heavy: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-fox: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-fox-fast: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-fox-heavy: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-deepslate: url("data:image/png;base64,");
--mc-glints: url("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABgAAAASCAYAAABB7B6eAAAANUlEQVR42mNgGAVYQOfz//9hbCZcihr+K/ynxHBkS2jqg1EwCqgEQpd4Db1kRW5GHQVDEAAA+QcVObg29+0AAAAASUVORK5CYII=");
--mc-craft: url("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABAAAAAQCAYAAAAf8/9hAAAAWUlEQVR42mNgGPKAEZlT6mX0nxhN3dvOwfWxIGv2c1In1uL/MEOYcKnYtO8mw6Z9N1H42AAT1cKAWP+jhwOKC2Bh4OekzoAcHjA+TAw5ECn2wsCHwShgYAAAxP8e/VSahzMAAAAASUVORK5CYII=");
--mc-book: url("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABAAAAAQCAYAAAAf8/9hAAAAUklEQVR42mNgGAWMyJxS2wn/CWnoPlyAoocFXUF6RgIhM/4jG8KCTcXMGQuwGjpzxgLCLsDlCmyacYYBsgEw12DTTFQYIPH/YzOEhZD/RwEdAAB/3SFAt83kmwAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==");
--mc-repeater: url("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABAAAAAQCAYAAAAf8/9hAAAAOUlEQVR42mNgGAXUB+9SUv6TIseETQE2hfjkKHIBIzLHzTfyPzHe3LV5OSOGF4jVjK6WaTTZDAIAADbEHYboywrjAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC");
--mc-paper: url("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABAAAAAQCAYAAAAf8/9hAAAAPklEQVR42mNgGAWM6AKTuhv+49OQV9qAoocFm6K42AismhctXoEhxoLLJmTFuAzEawA+TUPABdgCaxTQEAAA0bsRLbquYm4AAAAASUVORK5CYII=");
--mc-emerald: url("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABAAAAAQCAYAAAAf8/9hAAAAVElEQVR42mNgGAUUA0ZcEkrlQf+R+fc612FVy4JLs19eOIrYJgaG/9gMYSJGMwMDA4NfXjiGq7AaQCrAMOBe5zrGTZNWYijcNGkl1nCgOBBHARUAALOeHNHNs5UlAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC");
--mc-command: url("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABAAAAAQCAYAAAAf8/9hAAAASElEQVR42mNgGAWMyJxpiR7/idGUNX8HXB8LuqSvpyVezZu3H0fhsxCjCJ+hTLgkfD0tCboGpwuwuYIkA4ixGacBxNo8CqgIAGj6EOdcpnyTAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC");
}
/* This theme uses T3 Code's own controls and lifecycle indicators. */
:root.dark {
  --mc-slot: #14161a;
  --mc-slot-dark: #0b0c0e;
  --mc-slot-light: #2b303a;
  --mc-oak-edge: #3a3129;
  --mc-xp: #80ff20;
  --mc-branch: #38bdf8;
  --mc-amber: #f4c36e;
  --mc-error: #ff8585;
  --diff-addition-foreground: #69d6a1;
  --diff-deletion-foreground: #ff8585;
}
:root:not(.dark) {
  --mc-slot: #f8f9fb;
  --mc-slot-dark: #a9afbb;
  --mc-slot-light: #dce0e6;
  --mc-oak-edge: #c7b9a9;
  --mc-xp: #137442;
  --mc-branch: #116587;
  --mc-amber: #855012;
  --mc-error: #9e2222;
  --diff-addition-foreground: #137442;
  --diff-deletion-foreground: #a12525;
}
:root.dark :is([data-chat-canvas], [data-workspace-area="conversation"],
    [data-slot="sidebar-wrapper"], :has(> [data-slot="sidebar"])) {
  background-color: #121417;
  background-image: var(--mc-deepslate);
  background-size: 96px 96px;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
}
:root.dark [data-slot="sidebar"] {
  background-color: rgb(13 15 20 / 66%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(125%);
  border-inline-end: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 8%);
  box-shadow: inset 1px 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 7%);
}
:root.dark [data-slot="sidebar-inner"] { background-color: transparent; }
:root.dark [data-chat-composer-main-surface] {
  background-color: rgb(15 17 23 / 86%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}
:root.dark [data-thread-item] [data-sidebar-row][aria-current="page"]:has(.text-info-foreground svg) {
  background-image: linear-gradient(118deg, transparent 42%, rgb(168 85 247 / 12%) 49%, rgb(56 189 248 / 8%) 52%, transparent 59%);
  background-size: 250% 100%;
  animation: minecraft-enchantment 7s linear infinite;
  animation-play-state: var(--theme-motion-state, running);
}
:root.dark :is([data-chat-canvas], [data-slot="sidebar"], [data-slot="sidebar-inner"]) :is(img, video, canvas) {
  image-rendering: auto;
}
:is([data-slot="sidebar"], [data-slot="composer-host"], [data-thread-details-card],
    [data-slot="dialog-popup"], [data-slot="alert-dialog-popup"], [data-slot="sheet-popup"],
    [data-slot="popover-popup"], [data-slot="menu-popup"], [data-diffs-header],
    [data-chat-composer-top-drawer], [data-composer-command-drawer], [data-composer-stash-drawer],
    [data-user-message-bubble], .chat-markdown-codeblock, [data-chat-composer-main-surface],
    [data-slot="input"], [data-slot="button"], [data-slot="select-trigger"],
    [data-chat-composer-form] :is(input, textarea, button), [data-chat-header] button, [data-slot="sidebar"] button) {
  border-radius: 2px;
}
:is([data-chat-composer-main-surface], [data-chat-composer-top-drawer], [data-composer-command-drawer],
    [data-composer-stash-drawer], .chat-markdown-codeblock) {
  background-color: var(--mc-slot);
  border: 2px solid;
  border-color: var(--mc-slot-light) var(--mc-slot-dark) var(--mc-slot-dark) var(--mc-slot-light);
}
[data-chat-composer-main-surface]:focus-within { border-color: var(--ring, var(--accent)); }
[data-user-message-bubble] { border: 1px solid var(--mc-oak-edge); }
:root.dark :is([data-user-message-bubble], [data-thread-details-card]) {
  background-color: #191c22;
  border: 2px solid;
  border-color: var(--mc-slot-light) var(--mc-slot-dark) var(--mc-slot-dark) var(--mc-slot-light);
}
:root.dark [data-user-message-bubble] {
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, #30251e 24%, #191c22);
  border-inline-start-color: var(--mc-oak-edge);
}
[data-chat-composer-form] button:is([aria-label="Stop generation"], [aria-label="Stopping"]),
[data-mc-activity="Coding"] [data-chat-composer-compact-send],
[data-mc-activity="Reasoning"] [data-chat-composer-compact-send] {
  background-color: #d92b2b;
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 2px;
}
[data-chat-composer-form] button[aria-label="Stop generation"]:enabled:hover { background-color: #bf2525; }

:is([data-thread-now-line] .tabular-nums, [data-chat-thread-status-line] .tabular-nums,
    [data-mc-preview-status], [data-thread-item] [data-slot="badge"],
    [data-thread-item] .text-info-foreground:has(svg),
    [data-sidebar-row="shelf:working"], [data-sidebar-row="shelf:settled"]) {
  font-family: "Minecraft UI", ui-monospace, monospace;
  font-size: 10px;
}
[data-chat-canvas]:has(button[aria-label="Stop generation"]) [data-thread-now-line] > span:first-child,
[data-chat-canvas]:has(button[aria-label="Stop generation"]) [data-thread-now-line] .tabular-nums,
[data-chat-canvas]:has(button[aria-label="Stop generation"]) [data-chat-thread-status-line] > svg,
[data-thread-item] .text-info-foreground:has(svg),
[data-thread-item] :is([class~="bg-sky-500"], [class~="dark:bg-sky-300/80"]) {
  color: var(--mc-xp);
}
[data-thread-item] :is([class~="bg-sky-500"], [class~="dark:bg-sky-300/80"]) { background-color: var(--mc-xp); }
[data-chat-canvas]:has(button[aria-label="Stop generation"]) button:has(> svg.lucide-git-branch),
[data-mc-activity="Coding"] .checkout .preview-branch {
  color: var(--mc-branch);
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mc-branch) 9%, var(--mc-slot));
  border-radius: 2px;
}
:is(.text-diff-addition, .text-diff-addition-foreground) { color: var(--diff-addition-foreground); }
:is(.text-diff-deletion, .text-diff-deletion-foreground) { color: var(--diff-deletion-foreground); }

/* Keep the existing accessible control and replace just its artwork. */
:is([data-chat-header], [data-thread-details-card], [data-workspace-area="composer"]) svg:is(.lucide-git-branch, .lucide-git-branch-plus) {
  --mc-control-icon: var(--mc-craft);
  color: var(--accent);
}
:is([data-open-favorite-editor], [aria-label="Open in VS Code"], [title="Open in VS Code"]) svg { --mc-control-icon: var(--mc-book); }
:is([aria-label="Add project script"], [aria-label="Add action"]) svg { --mc-control-icon: var(--mc-repeater); }
[data-workspace-area="composer"] :is([aria-label="Attach files"] svg, svg.lucide-paperclip),
[data-composer-mention-chip] svg { --mc-control-icon: var(--mc-paper); }
[data-composer-skill] svg { --mc-control-icon: var(--mc-emerald); }
[data-composer-command-drawer] [data-slot="command-item"] svg.lucide-terminal { --mc-control-icon: var(--mc-command); }
:is([data-chat-header], [data-thread-details-card], [data-workspace-area="composer"]) svg:is(.lucide-git-branch, .lucide-git-branch-plus),
:is([data-open-favorite-editor], [aria-label="Open in VS Code"], [title="Open in VS Code"],
    [aria-label="Add project script"], [aria-label="Add action"]) svg,
[data-workspace-area="composer"] :is([aria-label="Attach files"] svg, svg.lucide-paperclip),
:is([data-composer-mention-chip], [data-composer-skill]) svg,
[data-composer-command-drawer] [data-slot="command-item"] svg.lucide-terminal {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  background: var(--mc-control-icon) center / contain no-repeat;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
}
:is([data-chat-header], [data-thread-details-card], [data-workspace-area="composer"]) svg:is(.lucide-git-branch, .lucide-git-branch-plus) > *,
:is([data-open-favorite-editor], [aria-label="Open in VS Code"], [title="Open in VS Code"],
    [aria-label="Add project script"], [aria-label="Add action"]) svg > *,
[data-workspace-area="composer"] :is([aria-label="Attach files"] svg, svg.lucide-paperclip) > *,
:is([data-composer-mention-chip], [data-composer-skill]) svg > *,
[data-composer-command-drawer] [data-slot="command-item"] svg.lucide-terminal > * { visibility: hidden; }

/* One companion per main composer. State is read from the current thread's own UI. */
[data-chat-canvas] {
  --mc-buddy-size: 64px;
  --mc-buddy-inset: 22px;
  --mc-model-mob: var(--mc-openai);
  --mc-model-fast: var(--mc-openai-fast);
  --mc-model-heavy: var(--mc-openai-heavy);
  --mc-buddy: var(--mc-picked-buddy, var(--mc-model-mob));
  --mc-standard-buddy: var(--mc-picked-buddy, var(--mc-model-mob));
  --mc-working-buddy: var(--mc-standard-buddy);
  --mc-pose: 0%;
  --mc-move: minecraft-idle 4s steps(1, end) infinite;
  --mc-indicator: var(--mc-elsewhere, none);
  --mc-indicator-ink: var(--accent, #38bdf8);
  --mc-sparks: none;
  --mc-sparks-motion: none;
  --mc-tier-glint: none;
  --mc-gear-glint: none;
}
[data-chat-canvas]:has([data-chat-provider-model-picker]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *):is(
  [aria-label*="claude" i], [aria-label*="haiku" i], [aria-label*="sonnet" i], [aria-label*="opus" i]),
  [data-chat-provider-model-picker]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *) [data-provider-kind="claude"]) {
  --mc-model-mob: var(--mc-claude);
  --mc-model-fast: var(--mc-claude-fast);
  --mc-model-heavy: var(--mc-claude-heavy);
}
[data-chat-canvas]:has([data-chat-provider-model-picker]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *):is([aria-label*="gemini" i], [aria-label*="antigravity" i])) {
  --mc-model-mob: var(--mc-gemini);
  --mc-model-fast: var(--mc-gemini-fast);
  --mc-model-heavy: var(--mc-gemini-heavy);
}
[data-chat-canvas]:has([data-chat-provider-model-picker]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *)[aria-label*="opencode" i]) {
  --mc-model-mob: var(--mc-opencode);
  --mc-model-fast: var(--mc-opencode-fast);
  --mc-model-heavy: var(--mc-opencode-heavy);
}
[data-chat-canvas]:has([data-chat-provider-model-picker]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *):is(
  [aria-label*="opus" i], [aria-label*=" pro" i], [aria-label*="o1" i], [aria-label*="o3" i],
  [aria-label*="sol medium" i], [aria-label*="sol high" i], [aria-label*="sol-medium" i],
  [aria-label*="sol-high" i], [aria-label*="sol, medium" i], [aria-label*="sol, high" i],
  [aria-label*="reasoning" i])) {
  --mc-working-buddy: var(--mc-picked-heavy, var(--mc-model-heavy));
  --mc-tier-glint: linear-gradient(125deg, transparent 39%, rgb(168 85 247 / 38%) 49%, rgb(125 211 252 / 35%) 54%, transparent 64%);
}
[data-chat-canvas]:has([data-chat-provider-model-picker]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *):is(
  [aria-label*="haiku" i], [aria-label*="flash" i],
  [aria-label*=" mini" i], [aria-label*="-mini" i], [aria-label^="mini" i],
  [aria-label*=" nano" i], [aria-label*="-nano" i], [aria-label^="nano" i],
  [aria-label*="sol low" i], [aria-label*="sol-low" i], [aria-label*="sol, low" i])) {
  --mc-working-buddy: var(--mc-picked-fast, var(--mc-model-fast));
  --mc-tier-glint: none;
}
:root:has([data-thread-item]:not([hidden]) [data-sidebar-row]:not([aria-current="page"], [aria-current="true"])
  :is([class~="bg-sky-500"], [class~="dark:bg-sky-300/80"], .text-info-foreground svg)) {
  --mc-elsewhere: "z";
}
[data-chat-canvas][data-mc-activity="Background"] { --mc-indicator: "z"; }
[data-chat-canvas]:where([data-mc-activity="Coding"], :has([data-workspace-area="composer"]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *) button:is([aria-label="Stop generation"], [aria-label="Stopping"]):not([hidden]))) {
  --mc-pose: 100%;
  --mc-buddy: var(--mc-working-buddy);
  --mc-move: minecraft-working .85s steps(1, end) infinite;
  --mc-indicator: "◆";
  --mc-indicator-ink: var(--mc-xp);
  --mc-sparks: var(--mc-glints);
  --mc-gear-glint: var(--mc-tier-glint);
  --mc-sparks-motion: minecraft-glints 4s steps(4, end) infinite;
}
[data-chat-canvas]:where([data-mc-activity="Reasoning"],
  :has([data-workspace-area="composer"]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *) button[aria-label="Stop generation"]):has(
    [data-v2-item-type="reasoning"]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *) :is(.live-tool-shine, .lucide-brain.text-foreground))) {
  --mc-pose: 50%;
  --mc-buddy: var(--mc-standard-buddy);
  --mc-move: minecraft-idle 2.2s steps(1, end) infinite;
  --mc-indicator: "◆";
  --mc-indicator-ink: var(--mc-xp);
  --mc-sparks: var(--mc-glints);
  --mc-gear-glint: none;
  --mc-sparks-motion: minecraft-glints 1.8s steps(2, end) infinite;
}
[data-chat-canvas]:where([data-mc-activity="Error"],
  :has([data-timeline-row-kind]:nth-last-child(1 of [data-timeline-row-kind]) [data-v2-item-type="error"]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *)),
  :has([data-thread-now-line][role="alert"]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *) > span:first-child > svg.text-warning-foreground)) {
  --mc-pose: 50%;
  --mc-buddy: var(--mc-standard-buddy);
  --mc-move: minecraft-hurt .38s steps(1, end) 2;
  --mc-indicator: "×";
  --mc-indicator-ink: var(--mc-error);
  --mc-sparks: none;
  --mc-gear-glint: none;
  --mc-sparks-motion: none;
}
[data-chat-canvas]:where([data-mc-activity="Approval"], :has([data-chat-composer-top-drawer]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *))) {
  --mc-pose: 50%;
  --mc-buddy: var(--mc-standard-buddy);
  --mc-move: none;
  --mc-indicator: "!";
  --mc-indicator-ink: var(--mc-amber);
  --mc-sparks: none;
  --mc-gear-glint: none;
  --mc-sparks-motion: none;
}
[data-chat-canvas] [data-chat-composer-main-surface]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *) { position: relative; }
/* Reserve the perch within the measured form, below the native status actions. */
[data-chat-canvas] :is([data-chat-composer-form], [data-chat-composer-form] *):not([data-side-chat-pane] *):has(> [data-chat-composer-main-surface]) {
  padding-block-start: var(--mc-buddy-size);
}
[data-chat-canvas] [data-chat-composer-main-surface]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *)::after {
  content: "";
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto var(--mc-buddy-inset) calc(100% - 6px) auto;
  z-index: 3;
  width: var(--mc-buddy-size);
  height: var(--mc-buddy-size);
  border: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  background: var(--mc-buddy) no-repeat var(--mc-pose) 0 / 300% 100%;
  animation: var(--mc-move);
  animation-play-state: var(--theme-motion-state, running);
}
[data-chat-canvas] [data-chat-composer-main-surface]:not([data-side-chat-pane] *)::before {
  content: var(--mc-indicator);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center end;
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto 8px calc(100% - 6px) auto;
  z-index: 3;
  width: 96px;
  height: 72px;
  pointer-events: none;
  border: 0;
  background: var(--mc-sparks) center / contain no-repeat,
    var(--mc-gear-glint) right 17px bottom 16px / 15px 15px no-repeat;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  animation: var(--mc-sparks-motion);
  animation-play-state: var(--theme-motion-state, running);
  color: var(--mc-indicator-ink);
  font: 10px/1 ui-monospace, monospace;
}
@keyframes minecraft-idle {
  76% { translate: 0 -1px; }
  88% { translate: 0 0; background-position-x: var(--mc-pose); }
  93% { background-position-x: 50%; }
  97% { background-position-x: var(--mc-pose); }
}
@keyframes minecraft-working { 50% { translate: 1px 0; } }
@keyframes minecraft-glints { 50% { background-position: center -4px, right 20px bottom 20px; } }
@keyframes minecraft-enchantment { from { background-position-x: 160%; } to { background-position-x: -60%; } }
@keyframes minecraft-hurt { 0% { filter: sepia(1) saturate(9) hue-rotate(318deg); } 55% { filter: none; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  :root.dark [data-thread-item] [data-sidebar-row][aria-current="page"]:has(.text-info-foreground svg) {
    background-image: none;
    animation: none !important;
  }
  [data-chat-canvas] [data-chat-composer-main-surface]::before,
  [data-chat-canvas] [data-chat-composer-main-surface]::after { animation: none !important; }
}
